about: Illustrative images on the demo seed's imaging reports (issue #386). Each is a real, de-identified person's image under CC0, shown only in the demo, labelled Illustrative image, never diagnostic. The seed refuses an image whose SHA-256 differs from the one here.

images.caption: Chest X-ray, PA view
images.label: Illustrative image
checks: licence page read through the Wikimedia Commons API: CC0 1.0, no share-alike, no non-commercial term, no data-use agreement
metadata stripped (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, comments: none left), greyscale, resized to 895x1024, JPEG quality 85
checked by eye: no name, date, ID or institution burned in; only the side markers 'Dx' and 'Sin'
matches the report: a normal PA chest radiograph for 'Normal chest radiograph'

images.caption: Lumbar spine MRI, sagittal T2
images.label: Illustrative image
checks: licence page read through the Wikimedia Commons API: CC0 1.0, no share-alike, no non-commercial term, no data-use agreement
metadata stripped (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, comments: none left), greyscale
cropped to 755x825 at +20+50 to remove the scanner overlay ('MR LUMBAR SPINE W WO', matrix, slice '6/12', sequence name, orientation letters); checked by eye: no text left
matches the report: a midline sagittal T2 slice with darker lower lumbar discs, no stenosis, for 'degenerative disc disease at L4-L5 and L5-S1'
